findings.title: Footer/out_of_scope clash if 1-7 ship
findings.description: M02 out_of_scopes changing keybindings and may not update footer hints for 1-7. M04 should explicitly update MainMenu footer line or depend_on M02 breadcrumb only and own footer digit hint.
findings.resolution: Digits moved to TW-02 which owns footer hint

findings.title: Two unrelated features in one milestone
findings.description: Toasts (new chrome subsystem) and menu digit keys (one handle_key match) share no code path. Prefer split: M04 toasts only; promote number keys to track tweak OR keep both but order keys first as quick win with interaction tests.
findings.resolution: M04 toasts only; TW-02 for menu keys

findings.title: Toast placement and tick model unspecified
findings.description: No design_decision: App-level Option toast vs component field; who owns Instant deadline; does update tick need App loop change; which actions fire toast (config save only vs stow complete). Runner will invent inconsistently.
findings.resolution: design_decisions for App toast + Instant deadline

findings.title: Number keys have no interaction test AC
findings.description: Labels already show 1-7; handling is trivial. AC must require cargo test -p andre --test interaction for digit dispatch, not only manual press.
findings.resolution: Number-key AC left M04; covered by TW-02
